description: This file defines the LocationService class that manages CLLocationManager interactions, including authorization handling, location updates, and significant change monitoring, with support for asynchronous operations and continuations.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: A final class responsible for managing location updates, handling authorization, and providing location data asynchronously.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Ensures the app has the requested authorization mode, requesting it if necessary.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Fetches the current location with specified parameters, handling timeouts.

methods.name: startLocationUpdates
methods.description: Starts location updates and returns an AsyncStream of CLLocation objects.

methods.name: stopLocationUpdates
methods.description: Stops ongoing location updates and terminates the stream.

methods.name: startMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges
methods.description: Begins monitoring for significant location changes with a callback.
